findings.title: Removed parse_optional_int is still imported by the test suite, so collection fails with ImportError
findings.problem: The diff deletes parse_optional_int from _filter_overrides.py. tests/test_filter_overrides.py:13 still imports it (`from ...web._filter_overrides import ..., parse_optional_int`), and tests at lines 155-170 call it. Pytest will raise ImportError when it collects the module, so every test in test_filter_overrides.py errors out. That includes the merge_overrides and parse_csv_list tests that have nothing to do with this change. I confirmed the import with a repository-wide grep.

members.title: Removing parse_optional_int breaks the import in tests/test_filter_overrides.py, so the whole test module fails to collect
members.problem: The diff deletes the public helper `parse_optional_int` from `roonseek.web._filter_overrides`. tests/test_filter_overrides.py:7-14 still imports it, and tests 15-17 at lines 151-170 call it. The working tree changes only the two src files (git status), so pytest will hit an ImportError when it collects tests/test_filter_overrides.py. That knocks out every test in the module, not just the three parse_optional_int tests: all the merge_overrides allowlist and type-validation tests (T-7-04 coverage) go silent at the same time. A grep of src/ found no other caller, so production code is not affected.

findings.title: Removing public helper parse_optional_int breaks an existing importer (test module fails to collect)
findings.problem: The diff deletes `parse_optional_int` from the public surface of `src/roonseek/web/_filter_overrides.py`, but `tests/test_filter_overrides.py` still imports it at line 13 and tests it at lines 155-170 (Tests 15-17). A grep of the repo confirms that file is the only remaining importer. Because the name is in a module-level `from ... import`, pytest raises an ImportError and the whole `test_filter_overrides.py` module fails to collect. That silently drops every `merge_overrides` and `parse_csv_list` test in the file along with the three `parse_optional_int` tests.
findings.fix_hint: either keep parse_optional_int (and keep calling it from _overrides_from_form) or delete the import and Tests 15-17 in tests/test_filter_overrides.py in the same change
findings.why_it_matters: The allowlist tests for filter overrides (T-7-04) are the main check on the module that pipeline.py, reconciliation.py, request.py and wanted.py all depend on. Losing them to a collection error hides future regressions, and the test suite may only report a single error, which is easy to miss.
